risk_if_not_implemented: Without Training Data Source & Integrity, personnel are more likely to make unsafe decisions, fall victim to social engineering, mishandle data or violate requirements. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to AI Output / Decision Integrity Failure (R-AI-1), AI Data Confidentiality / Integrity / Provenance Loss (R-AI-2), AI Bias / Discriminatory Outcome (R-AI-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Quality Operations
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to check for Redundant, Obsolete/Outdated, Toxic or Trivial (ROTT) data to ensure the accuracy, relevance, timeliness, impact, completeness and de-identification of information throughout the information lifecycle.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Quality Operations (DCH-33) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Training Data Source & Integrity (AAT-18.5) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to implement Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV) practices to enable Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related security, resilience and compliance-related conformity testing throughout the lifecycle of the AAT.
compensating_control_2.justification: Artificial Intelligence Test, Evaluation, Validation & Verification (AI TEVV) (AAT-28) provides periodic assessment and verification that compensates for the absence of Training Data Source & Integrity (AAT-18.5) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
